newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Aug 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Credit Agricole bank faces serious financial problems.
- U.S. Manpower firm to open a subsidiary in Morocco soon.
- Health workers are expected to go on a four-day strike.
- French Club Mediterranee plans to build new tourism villages in Morocco.
- Morocco's sate-owned power utility Office National de l'Electricite plans to invest 2.5 billion dirhams ($263 million) in a two-year period.
- Privatisation Minister Abderrahman Saaidi plans to introduce new procedures to speed up the government privatisation programme which aimes at ceding state stakes in 114 firms by end 1998.
- France granted Morocco 209.3 million French franc loan for water projects.
- State-owned compensation fund laid out 5.0 billion dirhams for commodity sectors to clear its arrears.
- Morocco's mutual funds disagree with new government tax imposed on stock market transactions.
- Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) 1996 report underlines the priority given to Morocco's social sectors.
